NOS-DOS Command Reference
=========================

NOS-SHELL (F-KEY REFERENCE)
-----------------------------
  F1   Help viewer
  F2   Configuration (sort order, display options)
  F3   View file (text viewer with scrolling)
  F4   Edit file (opens EDIT.COM)
  F5   Copy file/directory
  F6   Move / rename
  F7   Create directory
  F8   Delete (with confirmation)
  F9   Application launcher
  F10  Quit NOS-SHELL
  F12  Drop to DOS prompt  (EXIT to return)
  Tab  Switch active panel
  Ins  Select/deselect file
  Ctrl+R   Refresh both panels
  Alt+F4   Quit NOS-SHELL

NPKG - PACKAGE MANAGER
-----------------------
  NPKG UPDATE              Refresh package index from repository
  NPKG SEARCH [term]       Search packages by name/category/description
  NPKG SEARCH [term] [cat] Search within a category
  NPKG INFO [id]           Show full package details
  NPKG INSTALL [id]        Download, extract, configure package
  NPKG REMOVE [id]         Remove package and clean up
  NPKG LIST                List all installed packages
  NPKG PROFILE [id]        Show hardware requirements

  Categories: game  utilities  wordprocessing  spreadsheets
              databases  programming  communications

NNET - NETWORKING
-----------------
  NNET STATUS              Show network status and IP address
  NNET DHCP                Obtain IP via DHCP
  NNET PING [host]         Ping a host
  NNET WEB [url]           Fetch a web page (HTTP only)
  NNET FTP [host]          Open FTP session
  NNET TELNET [host]       Open Telnet session
  NNET IRC [server]        Connect to IRC server
  NNET TIME                Synchronise clock via NTP
  NNET CONFIG              Edit MTCP.CFG network configuration
  NNET LOOKUP [host]       DNS lookup

NBRIDGE - HOST BRIDGE
---------------------
  NBRIDGE STATUS           Show H:\ mount status and queue
  NBRIDGE MOUNT            Auto-detect and mount shared folder on H:\
  NBRIDGE DIRS             Create INBOX/OUTBOX/PRINT/CLIP on H:\
  NBRIDGE PRINT [file]     Spool file to H:\PRINT\PRINTnnn.PRN
  NBRIDGE CLIP GET         Display clipboard contents
  NBRIDGE CLIP PUT [text]  Write text to clipboard
  NBRIDGE CLIP CLEAR       Clear clipboard

  H:\ directory convention:
    H:\INBOX\    Host places files here for DOS
    H:\OUTBOX\   DOS places files here for the host
    H:\PRINT\    Print spool output (PRINTnnn.PRN)
    H:\CLIP\     Clipboard exchange (CLIP.TXT)

  TSRs (load in AUTOEXEC.BAT):
    NOSLPT              Hook LPT1 output to H:\PRINT\
    NOSLPT /U           Uninstall NOSLPT
    NOSCLIP             Clipboard hotkeys (Ctrl+Shift+C/V)
    NOSCLIP /U          Uninstall NOSCLIP

NOSPLAY - GAME LAUNCHER
-----------------------
  NOSPLAY                  Interactive game selector
  NOSPLAY [id]             Launch game with profile applied
  NOSPLAY LIST             List installed games
  NOSPLAY INFO [id]        Show game profile details

  Launch sequence: memory profile -> CPU throttle -> sound env -> game
  On exit: throttle removed, system returns to previous state.

THROTTLE / TCTL - CPU SPEED CONTROL
-------------------------------------
  THROTTLE                 Install CPU throttle TSR (level 0 = OFF)
  THROTTLE /L[n]           Install and set level 0-5 immediately
  THROTTLE /U              Uninstall
  THROTTLE /S              Show status

  TCTL STATUS              Show current throttle level
  TCTL SET [preset]        Set: OFF SLOW100 SLOW66 SLOW33 SLOW10 SLOW477
  TCTL CALIBRATE           Measure CPU speed and compute presets

  Hotkeys (while THROTTLE is loaded):
    Ctrl+Alt+KP+    Increase throttle (slower)
    Ctrl+Alt+KP-    Decrease throttle (faster)
    Ctrl+Alt+0      Disable throttle (OFF)

NOSMEM - MEMORY PROFILES
-------------------------
  NOSMEM /STD     Standard profile (all TSRs, 620KB+ free)
  NOSMEM /MAX     Maximum conventional (635KB+ free)
  NOSMEM /EMS     EMS emphasis (configure JEMMEX for 2-8MB EMS)
  NOSMEM /GAME    Game profile (sound+mouse only, max conventional)

NOSDETECT
---------
  Runs automatically on first boot. Detects hardware, generates
  CONFIG.SYS and AUTOEXEC.BAT. Re-run to reconfigure:
    DETECT         Run hardware detection

STANDARD DOS COMMANDS (FreeDOS)
---------------------------------
  DIR [path]           List directory
  CD [path]            Change directory
  COPY src dest        Copy file
  DEL [file]           Delete file
  MD [dir]             Create directory
  RD [dir]             Remove directory
  TYPE [file]          Display file contents
  EDIT [file]          Text editor
  MEM /C               Show memory map and free memory
  VER                  Show DOS version
  CLS                  Clear screen
